actual_behavior.existing_checkpoint: Persists state within an already-started run but does not subscribe to an external event stream or wake a published workflow at a per-event deadline.

expected_behavior: A published workflow must receive authorized external WebSocket events, reconnect and resubscribe, create or cancel one durable timer per business subject, wake at its deadline after a platform restart, and retain deduplication evidence.
missing_contract: A host-neutral optional event-automation module with a configurable authenticated WebSocket subscription trigger and a durable per-event timer operation. Home Assistant message mapping must remain workflow/source configuration.
